facts.fact: TechnoMag says Starlink's Lagos gateway at Equinix's Lekki data centre peers at IXPN Lagos, described as its largest African connection at 600 Gbps (Starlink's connection, not exchange traffic).
TechnoMag says Starlink's Lagos gateway at Equinix's Lekki data centre peers at AMS-IX Lagos.

note: Starlink is an ISP, not a content network, so no content fact; 600 Gbps is Starlink's port, not an exchange traffic figure.
